title: Register Muscle-Bone and Children's Rehabilitation
summary:
The monocentric register "Muscle-Bone Children’s Rehabilitation" has the aim of systematic data collection for quality assurance and continuous therapy optimization.
The study includes all patients at the Centre for Paediatric Rehabilitation at UniReha GmbH who have taken part in a rehabilitation programme since 2006.
The monocentric register " Muscle-Bone Children’s Rehabilitation " was established in 2009. Since then, the register is kept at the Center for children's rehabilitation of the UniReha GmbH, Clinics of the University of Cologne. So far, data collected in clinical routine (consent within the framework of the integrated supply contracts) were continuously retrospectively evaluated and published. The retrospective analyses showed the need to explore scientific questions of primary care prospectively in future.
For this reason, the current data collection is transferred in a prospective register to examine following questions:
1. Evaluation of the therapeutic effect after taking part in the concept „Auf die Beine“ in subgroups of cerebral palsy by severity and localization of damage.
2. Evaluation of the therapeutic effect in different other diseases, such as spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and rare diseases.
3. What patient groups will especially benefit from intensive, unit-based physical therapy?
4. The effect of intensity of training? (Parent report on the implementation of the home-based training)
5. Long-term development and sustainability of results.
6. Natural history of various diseases (before start of the concept).
7. Detection of possible side-effects.
8. Demographic data of various clinical pictures.
conditions: Spinal muscular atrophy and related syndromes
Specific developmental disorder of motor function
Disorders of myoneural junction and muscle in diseases classified elsewhere
Other chromosome abnormalities, not elsewhere classified

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients of the Center for Children's Rehabilitation are included in the monocentric register of UniReha GmbH.
Exclusion criteria:
All patients who are not taking part in a rehabilitation programme at the Centre for Paediatric Rehabilitation at UniReha Cologne.
